utterances.text: Hi Grandma! How have you been?
Oh, I've been lovely, dear! I was just getting the piano ready for our lesson today.
Yeah, I love sharing my favorite songs with you. Do you have any favorites from when you were my age?
I certainly do! But first, let's see how you've been practicing that Mozart piece I showed you.
Thanks, Grandma! I really appreciate your support. It means a lot to me that you're teaching me.
I understand, dear. Take your time with the scales and let me know if you need help with the fingering.
I'll definitely let you know, Grandma. By the way, what was your favorite song when you were my age?
It was a beautiful Chopin nocturne. We can take a break and I'll play it for you later if you like.
Thanks, Grandma. I think a break sounds good. Maybe we can listen to some of your favorite songs together?
That's a wonderful idea. I'm here to support your musical journey, whether we are playing or just listening.
No worries, Grandma. I appreciate you being here for me. Let's enjoy some music together.
That's wonderful to hear, dear! I'm glad you're enjoying the piano. Keep up the great work!
Thanks, Grandma! I'm really looking forward to it. Do you have a favorite song in mind to play next?
It sounds like you're really getting the hang of the rhythm! I'm so proud of you for sticking with it.
